svg.title: Figure 15 · Finite differences: a smaller bump can amplify noise
svg.desc: 80 repetitions, 4,096 paths per bump; seed 1010. The common-random-number version reuses each normal shock at both spots. This graph measures standard deviation, not total error: finite-difference bias must also be checked.
